Word embeddings are a type of word representation that allows words with similar meaning to have a similar representation. Word2Vec is a popular word embedding model that uses a sequence of vectors to represent words. It is trained on a large corpus of text and can be used for a variety of tasks, such as text classification, sentiment analysis, and machine translation.
